raw:
@q query
  select ?price1
  where match
    relation "cost"
    role subject "the Emirates flight to Cairo"
    role object ?price1
    role time "12 November"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?price2
  where match
    relation "cost"
    role subject "the Egyptair flight to Cairo"
    role object ?price2
    role time "12 November"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "cost less than"
    role subject ?f
    role object ?g
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?price1 below ?price2
